from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, tempfile, subprocess, os, shutil
root=Path('/Users/thomas/Projects/skills/.git/kntnt-orchestrate/395.scratch/native-unit-02/scratch')
private=root/'redline-mechanical-upqjl7_w'
original=Path('input.md').read_bytes()
mechanical_input=(private/'input.md').read_bytes()
final=(private/'output.md').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(mechanical_input).hexdigest() == 'c5adac71858c031ddc5f5b89edbf38b74f17c5963887d5e4d3018936f4c98a3b', 'Private input changed'
assert original == mechanical_input, 'Source changed'
print('Final equals original:', final == original)
print(final.decode(),end='')
tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='redline-uv-',dir=root)
try:
 p=subprocess.run(['uv','run','--no-cache','--no-project','.agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/article_anatomy.py','-'],input=final,env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':tmp,'UV_NO_CACHE':'1','UV_NO_PROJECT':'1'})
 if p.returncode not in (0,1,2): raise RuntimeError(p.returncode)
finally: shutil.rmtree(tmp)
evidence=root/'observer-evidence'
evidence.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(private/'input.md', evidence/'mechanical-pass-input.md')
shutil.copyfile(private/'output.md', evidence/'mechanical-pass-output.md')
shutil.rmtree(private)
assert not private.exists()
print('\nPrivate mechanical files removed; observer evidence retained.')
